answer: One concrete defense is a staked identity bond: each agent locks collateral before it can earn, and that stake is slashed on misbehavior. A sybil attacker cannot cheaply clone identities like saffron threads pulled from one flower, because every fake agent needs its own fresh bond. Honest reputation grows along a slow spiral of tenure, and attestations form a trellis where each node must be vouched for by established peers. To run a thousand sybils the attacker must fund a thousand bonds, so cost scales linearly with fakes while reward stays capped.
